title: The weight θH^n⌞M of an integer multiplicity current is independent of the representation (Simon 6.3.2(3))
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, n ∈ ℕ, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and let R_1 = (M_1, θ_1, ξ_1) and R_2 = (M_2, θ_2, ξ_2) be integer multiplicity triples in U (IMRep U n) both representing T (T = τ(M_1, θ_1, ξ_1) = τ(M_2, θ_2, ξ_2)). Then θ_1H^n⌞M_1 = θ_2H^n⌞M_2, i.e. R_1.measure = R_2.measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R₁.Represents T → R₂.Represents T → R₁.measure = R₂.measure
